scripts.dev: npm run build -w @arquitecture/core -w @arquitecture/server && concurrently -k -n servidor,interface "node packages/server/dist/main.js" "npm run dev -w @arquitecture/web"
scripts.pack: npm run build && npm pack -w arquitecture --pack-destination .pack
scripts.test:package: npm run build && npm run test:package -w arquitecture
scripts.test:e2e:dev: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -w @arquitecture/web
